key_logic.D-001: Three independent demo loops: job distance, profile/resume, and daily/weekly work reports.
key_logic.D-002: Exact address and home coordinates stay local; rotating nearby landmarks are used externally.
key_logic.D-003: Job discovery cannot directly modify the personal profile or resume.
key_logic.D-004: Scheduled public reads and limited local writes are allowed; external writes require confirmation.
key_logic.D-005: Root goal.md is authoritative; goal/ technical documents are subordinate and cannot change intent.
key_logic.D-006: Selected stack: pinned FastAPI template, LangGraph OSS, React/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, APScheduler worker, Docker Compose.
key_logic.D-007: Remote AI enters only through a local policy-controlled ModelProvider gateway.
key_logic.D-008: Upstream code is pinned and selectively imported without upstream Git or agent instructions.
key_logic.D-009: Bootstrap uses explicit Git boundaries and no public push, real personal data, or secrets without confirmation.
key_logic.D-010: LangGraph runs locally with PostgreSQL checkpoints and no required LangGraph cloud service.
key_logic.D-011: A network-free deterministic demo mode is separate from explicitly enabled live integrations.
key_logic.D-012: Finish deterministic local runtime evidence before live integrations and final documentation.
key_logic.D-013: Keep real operation, deterministic demo, live public-read, and privacy evidence distinct.
key_logic.D-014: Prefer read-only company ATS/Job Board APIs, beginning with Lever, before best-effort JobSpy; application POST endpoints remain prohibited.
key_logic.D-015: Separate target architecture decomposition from actual implemented graph nodes and completion evidence.
key_logic.D-016: Finish all no-decision freeze gaps and defer real model authorization, long-term preferences, tag, and public push.
key_logic.D-017: Resume failed Graphs on the same checkpoint thread, retain safe error history, and reject retry after success.
key_logic.D-018: A real remote-model call is optional authorized validation, not a mandatory local Demo freeze gate.
key_logic.D-019: Use Tauri 2, MapLibre GL JS, local PMTiles and Protomaps Basemaps for the offline street-level job radar; never send the home viewport to an external tile service.
key_logic.D-020: Use a minimal Tauri window capability set, persist only logical geometry, and keep scene/map data on configured localhost endpoints.
key_logic.D-021: Preserve the jointly verified Phase 7.1 through 7.3 work as one truthful local checkpoint instead of creating synthetic historical splits.
key_logic.D-022: Use a separate unibest/uni-app Vue 3 shell beside the existing React dashboard and Tauri Radar; verify Web now and defer WeChat and Android packaging.
key_logic.D-023: Implement Fitness as an independent uni-app module using the existing local FastAPI/PostgreSQL service as source of truth; use only a small cross-platform local draft cache for unsaved current inputs, and do not couple Fitness to Jobs, Profile/Resume, or Work Reporting.
key_logic.D-024: Present Fitness body parts without sequence numbers; use whole-card short tap for entry and 350ms long-press drag ordering on the home page while retaining exercise ordering controls in settings.
key_logic.D-025: Extract only stable repeated Fitness presentation contracts while keeping single-use page composition local and API/workflow orchestration in pages and Store.
key_logic.D-026: Allow arbitrary switching among exercises in one active Fitness plan, persist a per-exercise 1/2/2.5/5 kg weight step, retain retry IDs per draft, and derive a shared four-state workout banner from existing APIs.
key_logic.D-027: Use lime-echart 2.0.7 with Apache ECharts 5.4.3 for Fitness action trends; expose set-level and day-average modes with line/bar presentation and inside time zoom.
key_logic.D-028: Make the frontend presentation rules mandatory; standardize mobile on unibest plus Wot UI 2 and PC on React/Vite plus Ant Design, and require physical-device evidence for applicable mobile releases.
key_logic.D-031: Fitness Coach is an independent non-conversational server Graph; it may reuse shared runtime, Provider, Worker, PostgreSQL and audit infrastructure but reads and writes only Fitness-scoped data. DeepSeek deepseek-chat is the configured provider; missing key yields awaiting_configuration.
